You are a programming expert. 
You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From ffea9fb319360b9ead8befac6bb2db2b54fd53e6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Date: Wed, 16 Mar 2022 13:41:46 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] sched/headers: ARM needs asm/paravirt_api_clock.h too

Add <asm/paravirt_api_clock.h> for arch/arm/, mapped to <asm/paravirt.h>,
to simplify #ifdeffery in generic code.

Fixes this build error introduced by the scheduler tree:

  In file included from ../kernel/sched/core.c:81:
  ../kernel/sched/sched.h:87:11: fatal error: asm/paravirt_api_clock.h: No such file or directory
     87 | # include <asm/paravirt_api_clock.h>

Reviewed-by: Nathan Chancellor <nathan@kernel.org>
Fixes: 4ff8f2ca6ccd ("sched/headers: Reorganize, clean up and optimize kernel/sched/sched.h dependencies")
Signed-off-by: Randy Dunlap <rdunlap@infradead.org>
Signed-off-by: Ingo Molnar <mingo@kernel.org>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20220316204146.14000-1-rdunlap@infradead.org

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File Added**: 
   - `asm/paravirt_api_clock.h`: This header file has been added for the ARM architecture. It is mapped to `asm/paravirt.h` to streamline conditional compilation in the generic code.

2. **File Modified**:
   - `kernel/sched/sched.h`: The inclusion of the header `<asm/paravirt_api_clock.h>` has been added to this file. This change addresses a build error that occurred due to the absence of the header file.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The addition of `asm/paravirt_api_clock.h` is directly related to the modification in `kernel/sched/sched.h`, as the latter file now includes the newly added header. This inclusion resolves a build error that was introduced in a previous commit (4ff8f2ca6ccd) during the reorganization and optimization of the scheduler's header dependencies. The patch effectively fixes the build issue by ensuring that the necessary header is available for the ARM architecture, thereby simplifying the conditional compilation logic in the scheduler code.
